description: A technical resource and newsletter for commercial and specialty insurance underwriters.
tagline: The technical briefing for working underwriters.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our technical writers research and compile practical insights for commercial lines underwriting.

editorial.how_we_test: We consult working underwriters and subject matter experts to review technical accuracy before publication.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We are fully funded by insurtech and industry sponsorships, operating as a trade publication.
editorial.corrections_policy: Factual errors are corrected in the text with a dated correction notice at the bottom of the article.
